$comment: Per-repo values for the sydevs `workflow` plugin and its skills. The skills hold the rules. docs/ holds the stories.

contractStep.description: Payload migrations. Attempt first, then hand off if it hangs.
contractStep.onExit124: Hand off to the user. Do not retry.

securityReview.rationale: Paths that own access control, client and manager records, endpoints, collection hooks (where write gates live), storage, and the Payload config — plus passwordless sign-in (token signing, session minting, the anonymous routes and sign-in page), the preview admin whose email is its credential, the write guard on client-originated writes, and origin enforcement for client keys — plus the admin components, where a server field component answers `form-state` for a caller-chosen row and so owes its own read gate (docs/rules/admin-ui.md, #1126).

worktreeNotes: .env is git-tracked, so it is already present. The dev server needs a distinct PORT (shared local Postgres via push: true).

previewUrl.$comment: Every PR preview is reached at its fixed address, keyed on the pull request NUMBER, so the host is known the moment the PR exists and cannot collide. Railway's own host is shut to a browser (DEPLOYMENT.md, "Previews are gated"). finalize-pr writes deep links from it rather than waiting for the build. (why: sydevs/claude-workflow docs/why.md#construct-a-number-discover-a-slug)

fixture.$comment: Every preview loads src/fixture/ into itself at boot, each row at a pinned id, so a link to one is built from the diff and never by opening the preview (src/fixture/AGENTS.md, sydevs/SahajCloud#1168).
